name: siheom-ts
description: siheom monorepo — data-first frontend test interpreter

scripts.ci: bun run check-format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run check-exports && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/vue' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/svelte' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/angular' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/qwik' build
scripts.check-exports: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/vue' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/svelte' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/angular' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/qwik' check-exports
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/vue' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/svelte' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/angular' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/qwik' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' typecheck
scripts.test: mise exec -- sh -c "bun run --filter '@siheom/core' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/vue' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/svelte' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/angular' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/qwik' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' test"
scripts.local-check: bun run format && bun run lint:fix && bun run build && bun run check-exports && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' test
scripts.dup:nose: nose query -r packages/core/src -r packages/react/src -r apps/react-example/test top=20
scripts.dup: bun run dup:jscpd && bun run dup:nose

author: Taehee Kim <rabolution@gmail.com> (https://x.com/stelo_kim)
